# Good patient-facing questions: every line must be allowed (M1-07). Synthetic.
What brings you in today?
When did this start?
How bad is your pain from 0 to 10?
Where does it hurt?
Do you have any chest pain?
Does the pain spread to your arm or jaw?
Are you short of breath?
Have you been sweating a lot?
Have you had a fever?
Have you had shivers you could not stop?
Is one side of your face drooping?
Is one of your arms weak?
Is your speech slurred?
When did you last feel completely normal?
Do you have any allergies to medicines?
Is your child hard to wake up?
Is your child feeding less than usual?
Can you tell me a bit more about how you feel?
Did you hurt yourself?
Have you taken any medicines today?
Thank you. A nurse will be with you shortly. Please stay here.
Could you point to where the pain is?
Do you have a headache?
